mapper.select: SELECT p.paragraph_id, p.order_number, pu.content FROM paragraph_updates pu INNER JOIN paragraphs p ON pu.paragraph_id = p.paragraph_id AND pu.episode_id = p.episode_id LEFT JOIN paragraph_deletes pd ON pd.paragraph_id = pu.paragraph_id AND pd.episode_id = pu.episode_id WHERE p.episode_id = #{episodeId} AND pd.paragraph_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.order_number ASC
mapper.insert:

(#{item.paragraphId}, #{item.episodeId}, #{item.postId}, #{item.content})

(#{item.paragraphId}, #{item.episodeId}, #{item.postId})
